speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fatigue and difficulty to concentrate. I also have Dyspnea on exertion, Dizziness, Digital pain that improves with cold.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Essential Thrombocythemia (likely with associated microvascular disturbances such as erythromelalgia). The combination of severe thrombocytosis, symptoms of cold-induced digital pain (erythromelalgia), fatigue, and dyspnea, alongside confirmed iron deficiency (likely secondary to bleeding or hyporesponsiveness), points to a myeloproliferative neoplasm.
